title: SentinelOne Ontology Entity
description: One entity in the tenant-derived SentinelOne ontology (Phase 2, Milestone 2). Generated only from data/knowledge/sentinelone/environment_map.yaml -- never fabricated. A tenant's ontology.yaml is an array of these.

entity.description: Entity name as it actually appears in this tenant's data (e.g. Alert, Vulnerability, Misconfiguration, InventoryItem, Storyline).

description.description: One-line description of what this entity represents in this tenant.

attributes.description: Real attributes observed on this entity, with population noted -- not the full documented field list if some fields never occur in this tenant.

name.description: Attribute name as returned by the tool (e.g. severity, analystVerdict, storylineId).

type.description: Observed JSON type (string, integer, boolean, object, array).

population.description: How often this attribute actually carries a value in this tenant's data, per Milestone 1 discovery -- not assumed from the API schema alone.

enum_ref.description: Name of an entry in this entity's enums map, if this attribute's values are enumerated.

relationships.description: Edges to other entities, e.g. Alert -> Asset, Vulnerability -> Asset, Alert -> Storyline.

via_attribute.description: The attribute on this entity that carries the foreign reference (e.g. storylineId, assetId).

enums.description: Decoded enum tables for this entity's enumerated attributes. Keys are enum names referenced from attributes[].enum_ref; values are the real, observed set of codes mapped to human-readable labels -- not the full documented range if some values never occur here.

lifecycle_states.description: Ordered or graph-like lifecycle states this entity moves through (e.g. NEW -> IN_PROGRESS -> RESOLVED), if applicable.

tool_bindings.description: Which MCP tools answer questions about this entity, and for what purpose.

tool.description: MCP tool name as listed in data/knowledge/sentinelone/mcp_tools.md (e.g. search_alerts, get_vulnerability).

purpose.description: What this tool call is for with respect to this entity, e.g. 'lookup by ID', 'filtered search', 'count-only query'.

in_scope.description: False if this entity comes from a generic decomposition but is not actually present/licensed in this tenant -- kept for future reference, excluded from current routing.

reviewed_by.description: Analyst sign-off identifier/date, required before this entity is frozen into a versioned ontology release.
